feature: Anything you draw on a video gets its own row on the timeline
summary: A rectangle, line, arrow, lens, measurement or picture drawn on a recording now lands on its own timeline row, named after it, from the playhead to the end of the shot. A diamond on that row keys it, and dragging it later on the canvas makes the next key, so it tweens.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open a recording, pause, and put the playhead at 1s.
Press R for the rectangle tool and drag a box on the picture. A Rectangle row appears above V1.
Move the playhead to 3.5s and press End Here in the Time section, or drag the right end of its bar.
Back at 1s, click the diamond beside Rectangle on its row header.
Move the playhead to 3s and drag the rectangle across, then drag a corner to grow it.
Scrub from 0s to 4s, or press Space.
Right-click the Rectangle bar with the playhead on it: Add Key or Remove Key is in the menu.

evaluate: Is running from the playhead to the end of the shot the right default, or would you rather it ran a fixed few seconds like a title does?
Is the diamond on the row header where your hand goes to key a layer, next to the name?
Should a shape's row be named after the shape (Rectangle, Arrow) or numbered like Premiere (V2, V3)?
Does one diamond keying position, size, angle and opacity together feel right, or do you want only what you then change to stay keyed?
rough: K is not bound to add a key: on the timeline K is Premiere's Stop and on the canvas it is the Lens tool. The row diamond and the bar's right-click do it instead.
The row header is 84 points wide, so with the diamond and the lanes arrow the name reads Recta... in the header; the bar itself says Rectangle in full.
Before the layer arrives (0.5s) its diamonds read as on a key, because the first key is where it starts; the motion path of the picked layer also stays drawn while the layer is off screen.
A resize while Scale is keyed becomes a uniform scale key, so stretching one side only is not keyed.
The header diamond is not in the video mock; the mock has no keyed graphic row. The rest of the row is the mock's track, bar and lanes.
